desc: Everything about NextFloor, the free 3D floor plan for Home Assistant: install, draw your home, connect devices, build cards, write plugins.
title: Draw your home once. Watch it live in 3D.
sub: NextFloor turns Home Assistant into a living 3D model of your house: lamps light their room, blinds move, doors open, the TV shows what plays. Free, local, no account.
shotAlt: A house in NextFloor's 3D view with lit rooms and the floors apart
pathsLead: The documentation follows the way you actually work. Pick the door that fits today.

paths.title: I am new here
paths.text: Install NextFloor, draw the first room, place a lamp and switch it from the 3D view. About fifteen minutes, nothing to prepare.

paths.title: I want my devices in it
paths.text: Link lights, blinds, sensors, the TV, the car and the garden to the plan.

paths.title: I want to build on it
paths.text: Dashboard card, automations, plugins and your own furniture.

tourLead: Everything below is built in and free, and works with the devices you already have.

tour.title: A plan editor that feels like a game
tour.text: Floors, rooms, curved walls, doors, windows, stairs, roofs and gardens, with the 3D model growing beside the plan while you draw. Import a scan, a CAD drawing or a Sweet Home 3D plan instead of starting from zero.
tour.alt: The plan editor with the 3D view beside it

tour.title: Furnish it with 800 models, or build your own
tour.text: Forty basic models and forty-three free packs, from IKEA-style sofas to picture frames with your own photos. The furniture studio and the browser builder make anything that is missing.
tour.alt: Furniture from several packs in a room

tour.title: Tap a lamp, watch the room answer
tour.text: Lights glow in their real colour, blinds travel, windows and doors open, the TV shows what plays, rain falls outside. The room panel puts every device of a room in one place.
tour.alt: A room in 3D with its lamps and the room panel

tour.title: Climate, sun and energy, by room
tour.text: Heat maps for temperature, humidity, CO₂ and mould risk, the hours of sun per room, and the power flow along the real cable routes of your house.
tour.alt: The house with the energy flow from the solar field

tour.title: Made for the wall tablet
tour.text: A dashboard card with a visual editor, kiosk mode that dims at night, announcements on every screen, and quality that steps down by itself on slow hardware.

promiseTitle: Free forever, and the licence says so
promise: Every feature, every furniture pack and every update is free for everyone. There is no Pro version, no paid add-on, no supporter pass and no licence key.
Your data stays in your Home Assistant. No account, no cloud, no usage data. NextFloor is MIT licensed, so nobody can take it away, not even its author.
